text:
marie-sales: Quick sync — customer (mid-market fintech) requested an on-prem POC. they're asking for platform fee to be waived and Gold support during test. Need guidance on precedent and approvals.
ashley-se: How large is the footprint for the POC? CPU/GPU counts, expected concurrent requests?
marie-sales: They said 3–5 nodes for the POC, ~40–60 rps, synthetic load tests only. Potential to convert to 24-node Private deployment if successful.
sam-revenueops: Historically: one-time Platform Deployment Fee ranges $30k–$80k depending on packaging and migration effort. For POCs we sometimes offer partial or full waivers for strategic accounts in exchange for conversion commitments.
ashley-se: Technical ask: KMS integration + VPN tunnel + initial packaging. Estimate 3 engineering days for KMS/HSM setup and 5 days SRE time to validate deployment and run acceptance tests.
liam-dealdesk: If recommending a waiver, we need: (1) a signed MOU committing to pursue paid Private license within X days, (2) minimum ARR on conversion, (3) finance-approved fallback billing if conversion doesn't happen.
marie-sales: Proposed commercial motion: Waive $45k platform fee for POC. Customer pays POC support (Gold) at $9k for the test window. Conversion: 12-month Private license with min ARR $150k. First year 20% discount. MOU to be signed within 30 days of POC completion.
sam-revenueops: That seems reasonable. Add clause: waived amount recorded as conditional credit in billing. If no conversion within 90 days after POC, customer will be invoiced the waived amount net of any paid support. Finance must sign off.
devon-cs: Support tiers reminder: Standard (email only, included), Gold (24x7 with 2hr response, +12% of annual license), Platinum (TAM + dedicated pager, +25%). For POC we can bill Gold as short-term add-on.
security-bot: Automated check: On-prem deployments require completed security questionnaire, signed KMS attestation, and customer-provided network diagram before engineers are granted access.
ashley-se: I'll draft an SOW snippet for the Platform Deployment Fee + POC acceptance criteria (latency targets, throughput, test dataset pass rate) so waiver is contingent on pass.
marie-sales: SOW snippet draft: ```
Platform Deployment Fee (Private/On-Prem): Covers packaging, delivery, and initial deployment support for customer-managed infrastructure, including VPN, KMS/HSM integration, and initial performance tuning. One-time fee: $45,000. Waiver eligible for POC under an approved MOU that includes a conversion commitment and minimum ARR.
POC Acceptance Criteria: 99th percentile latency <= 300ms on specified workload, sustained throughput >= 40 RPS for 1 hour, and successful KMS/HSM key rotation test.```
liam-dealdesk: Please include exact legal milestones: MOU signature, invoice fallback date, and SLA obligations during POC. Also route the discount request with ARR forecast to legal + finance. I'll expedite.
marie-sales: One more operational ask: if we waive the fee, we still need to track internal cost (SRE time). I'll add estimated effort lines in SOW for chargeback.
sam-revenueops: Agreed. Also note: if customer asks for code or bundled on-prem artifacts, include export compliance and license language in SOW.
liam-dealdesk: Next steps: @marie-sales send the formal ask email with the proposed numbers, attach SOW snippet and MOU template. I'll route to finance and legal and aim for decision within 48 business hours.
marie-sales: Sent. tagging here for visibility. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
